title: bardolier teardown output
description: Reversing a README Install: containers stopped, PATH links and config removed, base images too under --images. cli-spec.md §6 (Lifecycle / SSD). Never touches a project directory or a named volume.

confirmed.description: False when the user declined the confirmation; nothing else in this payload was touched.

stopped.description: Projects down-all stopped on the way, sorted.

stray_containers.description: bardolier-* containers removed that no manifest claimed.

docker_available.description: False when the daemon was unreachable — containers, symlinks and config are handled regardless.

config_dir.description: ~/.config/bardolier (or $BARDOLIER_CONFIG's directory) — config.yml and the root index both live here.

config_removed.description: False when there was nothing there to begin with.

unlinked.description: bardolier/bdlr links this checkout owned and removed, across every conventional bin directory.

images_removed.description: Base image tags removed — only when --images was passed. Empty, not omitted, otherwise.
